cdp.ends.title1.zh: 第 1 集为什么提前结束

cdp.ends.titleLater.zh: 后续各集为什么提前结束

cdp.ends.info.en: Views that stopped before the episode ended and before moving on, by what the phone reported. Something went wrong: it froze, never started, the phone paused it, or it failed. They chose to stop: it was playing, or they paused it. Unknown: the page closed without a word. Recorded since Sep 25.
cdp.ends.info.zh: 在本集结束前、也没有切到下一集就停下的观看，按手机上报的情况分类。出了问题：卡住、没开始、被手机暂停或播放失败。自己停下：视频在播放，或自己暂停。未知：页面没有任何信息就关闭了。自 9 月 25 日起记录。

cdp.ends.none.en: No reports yet for these filters. The player has sent them since Sep 25.
cdp.ends.none.zh: 这些筛选条件下还没有报告。播放器自 9 月 25 日起发送。

cdp.end.left_phone_paused.en: Left after the phone paused it

cdp.end.closed_paused_by_phone.en: Vanished after the phone paused it

cdp.info.frame.en: Median time from the tap (episode 1) or the swipe (later episodes) to the first video frame.
cdp.info.frame.zh: 从点按（第 1 集）或滑动（后续各集）到视频第一帧的中位时间。

cdp.info.freezes.en: Share of views where the video froze to load after it had started.
cdp.info.freezes.zh: 视频开始后又卡住加载的观看占比。

cdp.info.phone.en: Share of views where the phone paused the video while the page was on screen; the player then restarted it.
cdp.info.phone.zh: 页面在屏幕上时被手机暂停的观看占比；播放器随后会重新播放。

cdp.info.views.en: Episode views with a playback report.
cdp.info.views.zh: 有播放报告的单集观看次数。

cdp.split.info.en: On the episode the page opened on, from the tap: the page arriving, the player getting ready, then the video's first frame. Averages.
cdp.split.info.zh: 在打开页面的那一集上，从点按算起：页面到达、播放器就绪、视频第一帧。平均值。

cdp.split.pageInfo.en: From the tap until the page arrived.

cdp.split.playerInfo.en: From the page arriving until the player was ready.
cdp.split.playerInfo.zh: 从页面到达到播放器就绪。

cdp.split.videoInfo.en: From the player being ready until the first frame: the video loading.
cdp.split.videoInfo.zh: 从播放器就绪到第一帧：视频加载。

cdp.split.none.zh: 还没有测量到开始时间。

cdp.drops.info.en: The latest views that ended early, one by one. Open one to see what happened, second by second. A viewer shows as a short code, never who they are.
cdp.drops.info.zh: 最近提前结束的观看，逐条列出。展开可以逐秒查看发生了什么。观众只显示为短代码，不显示身份。

cdp.drops.none.en: No early endings in this period yet.
cdp.drops.none.zh: 这段时间内还没有提前结束的观看。
